ns2:course.label: Directed Research
ns2:course.description: Restricted to students satisfying requirements for the master's degree by writing a substantial essay. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. Normally taken for 8 hours credit but may be taken for 12 hours credit with consent of department chair.
